news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro (CLPT) Stock Falls on Q2 2026 Earnings
news.summary: Shares of ClearPoint Neuro fell sharply after the Q2 revenue miss and guidance cut, with analysts Lake Street and Stifel trimming their price targets to $25 (from $30) and $22 (from $25) respectively. The stock closed well below its 52-week high of $30.10 as investors weighed rising cash burn against the company's long-term growth narrative.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Aug 2026 slides: $500m revenue target amid Q2 miss
news.summary: Alongside its Q2 report, ClearPoint Neuro unveiled a five-pillar strategy targeting $500 million in annual revenue, combining neurosurgery navigation, CRO/preclinical services, its IRRAS neurocritical-care business, and eventual commercial cell and gene therapy delivery royalties. Much of the additional upside depends on biopharma partners reaching commercial drug launches starting in 2027.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro posted Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9 million, up 18% year-over-year but about $1.8 million below consensus, with neurosurgery navigation and therapy revenue up 62% while biologics and drug delivery revenue declined 15% on fewer biopharma trial initiations. The company cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48-52 million, and cash fell to $29.4 million from $45.9 million at the start of the year as operating expenses rose 51% on the IRRAS integration.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: The FDA granted RMAT designation to Aspen Neuroscience's sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous dopaminergic cell therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula in the Phase 1/2a ASPIRO trial. The designation enables more frequent FDA interaction and a potential accelerated approval path, validating ClearPoint's delivery-platform role with a key cell-therapy partner.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease in Q3 2026 after the FDA agreed 3-year Phase I/II data can support accelerated approval; ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula/navigation platform is used for delivery in the program.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro is expected to report Q3 2026 results in early November, based on its prior-year reporting cadence, with investors watching whether the cut $48-52M full-year guidance holds.

catalysts.label: $500M five-pillar revenue roadmap
catalysts.detail: Management's long-term plan layers commercial cell/gene therapy delivery royalties on top of existing device, CRO, and neurocritical-care revenue, but depends on biopharma partners reaching commercial drug launches starting in 2027.

catalysts.label: Focused ultrasound / robotics platform development
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint continues developing its robotic surgical platform and Harmony 1.0 software alongside its focused ultrasound drug-delivery partnership with Sungkyunkwan University's SONOCARE Lab in South Korea.

catalysts.label: Potential first commercial cell/gene therapy launches
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint says more than 60 biopharma partner programs use its delivery platform, with several under FDA expedited review pathways; management believes additional cell and gene therapies could reach commercial launch by the end of 2027.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro's stock has been under heavy pressure since its August 3, 2026 Q2 report showed 18% revenue growth to $10.9 million but missed Wall Street estimates, prompting a cut to full-year 2026 guidance ($48-52M) and price-target reductions from Lake Street and Stifel. Management is leaning on a longer-term '$500 million' five-pillar strategy spanning navigation devices, CRO/preclinical services, neurocritical care (IRRAS), and eventual commercial cell/gene therapy delivery royalties, with encouraging regulatory milestones in July-August from partners Aspen Neuroscience (RMAT designation) and uniQure (accelerated BLA pathway for AMT-130). Cash fell to $29.4 million amid rising integration-related opex, keeping near-term dilution and burn-rate risk in focus even as the multi-year gene-therapy-enablement thesis remains intact.
